entities.summary: Anton Rintelen was an Austrian academic, jurist and politician. Initially associated with the right wing Christian Social Party, he became involved in the July Putsch, a Nazi coup d'état plot, in 1934. Anton Rintelen was a jurists & legal scholars from Graz (1876-11-15, Graz–1946-01-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
